## About
Gino's Auto Body Shop, run as Matticoli Brothers, Inc., is a family-owned and operated body shop that has stayed in the same spot in Princeton since it opened. We serve drivers across Central New Jersey, from small fixes to major collision damage.
Our mechanics and painters measure the chassis before and after a repair, mix paint right here in the shop, and work for all insurance companies. If your car can't be driven, we can arrange the tow and point you to a rental.
Neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating from 162 Google reviews. Give us a call or stop by on a weekday and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Free computer written estimates: Every estimate is written up by computer so you can see what the repair involves.
- Computerized chassis measurements: We measure before and after a repair so the chassis goes back to manufacturer's specifications.
- Frame and unibody repair: Vehicles are anchored on a Chief frame machine and pulled until the chassis is square, then sheet metal is replaced and aligned.
- Spray bake refinishing: Down draft booths keep dust and overspray down, and the booth ovens bake the finish to help the paint cure.
- Work for all insurance companies: We accept damage appraisals written for any insurance company and are happy to answer your questions.
- Wheel alignment: Alignments done on our Hunter alignment machine.
- Towing service: We arrange towing for local customers and can add charges from other carriers to the repair estimate.
- Rental car pick-up and delivery: A national rental company offers our customers free pick-up and delivery at the shop. Ask us for the number of the closest office.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work for all insurance companies and accept damage appraisals written for any insurance company. We're happy to answer questions along the way.

Q: How long does an estimate take?
A: On average, an estimate takes about 20 minutes.

Q: My car isn't drivable. Can you help with towing?
A: We arrange towing for local customers. If another carrier has towing or storage charges, we pay them and add the charge to the repair estimate.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: All foreign and domestic vehicles, from cars to light trucks.
